  WHY: The subsequent `[ -f "${pool_rejected_file}" ]` then returns true and `pool_rejected_kept_bytes="$(wc -c …)"` reads the stale size, contradicting the agents.md contract "0 when the copy failed" and reporting evidence that belongs to a different attempt.

  WHY: The existing assertions check the log line only up to `reason=`, so the new fields' exact values are not positively verified, and no test simulates a failed copy to confirm `kept_bytes=0` actually lands on disk.
